_comment: Dev profile 'Dev: Live crypto + all strategies' (DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=DevLiveAll). Skips login and auto-connects the five KEYLESS crypto feeds — real live bars / L1 / L2 / trade tape with no API key, no account, no TWS. Binance is the live-verified backend; Coinbase/Bybit/Kraken/OKX are wired but unverified live, and a feed that fails to connect is logged to the Activity Log, never fatal. The strategy catalog is NOT populated by this file: run tools/dev-stage-strategies.ps1 once to build the first-party strategies from the local DaxAlgo-Terminal-Strategies checkout into the App output's plugins/ folder. Use 'Dev: Live (no login)' instead if you want Interactive Brokers.
_accountGate: The launch profile ALSO passes --bypass-login, and needs to: the account/entitlement gate runs before anything else and only trusts the local development adapter for the environment names hard-coded in DevelopmentAccountProviderPolicy (Development / DevSim / DevReplay / DevLive). 'DevLiveAll' is not one of them, so without the flag the gate falls through to 'Account access unavailable' and the shell never opens. --bypass-login waives the gate outright, in Debug builds only. If that allow-list ever gains DevLiveAll, the flag becomes optional here.

Plugins._comment: Permissive + Off so locally built, unsigned plugin folders load without a consent prompt and the IL policy scan can't quarantine one you're iterating on. Dev only — the shipped appsettings.json stays Curated + Enforce.

MarketDataStore._comment: Explicit (not inherited) so this profile's intent is obvious next to DevSim, which turns persistence off: live ticks land in the per-broker store, one file per broker per stream.
